old_novelty.CS018: CS005 defines a handoff envelope; CYB006 bounds retry workload and CS015 allocates frame ownership. This course instead defines identity-scoped replay semantics, distinguishing equal replay from conflicting payload under the same identity.
old_novelty.CYB012: CYB008 derives contraction with the current residual. This course introduces a one-update observation delay and compares characteristic roots and exact traces; repeated observations do not imply fresh feedback.

new_novelty.CS018: CS005 defines a handoff envelope; CS015 already assigns overlapping frame ownership, assumes equal duplicate payloads and retains conflicts. This course adds an order-independent identity-to-payload-set merge: pointwise union is associative, commutative and idempotent, and a conflict persists under further merge; accepted totals are derived only after validation.
new_novelty.CYB012: CYB008 section 4 already introduces a one-update residual delay and derives an unstable root counterexample. This course adds the complete scalar delayed-gain stability interval 0 < gain < 1, proves real, repeated and complex root cases and excluded boundaries, then compares stable and nondecaying exact traces. Finite traces illustrate the proof; they do not prove general stability.
